svg.title: Autonomous AI Code Review Agent - N8N workflow diagram
svg.desc: Flowchart showing the 18-node N8N workflow: schedule trigger, GitHub fetch, filter, loop, AI review via EPAM DIAL, severity routing, GitHub comments, Teams notifications, and agent memory.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the N8N schedule trigger work?')
sendPrompt('How does the Fetch Open Pull Requests node work?')
g.text: GitHub API - up to 10 open PRs

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the Extract and Filter New PRs node work?')
g.text: Skips already-reviewed PR IDs from memory

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the IF New PRs node check?')
sendPrompt('What Teams message is sent when there are no new PRs?')
sendPrompt('How does the Loop Over PRs node work?')
sendPrompt('What does Fetch PR File Diffs retrieve from GitHub?')
sendPrompt('How does the Build Rich Review Prompt node work?')
sendPrompt('How does the DIAL API AI Code Review node call GPT-4o?')
sendPrompt('How does the Parse AI Review node extract fields?')
sendPrompt('What triggers the CRITICAL path in IF Critical?')
sendPrompt('What do the critical GitHub comment and Teams alert contain?')
sendPrompt('What does the normal GitHub comment and Teams summary contain?')
sendPrompt('What does the Teams critical alert look like?')
sendPrompt('What does the Teams review summary contain?')
